statement: For the specified point-independent slope-bucket join, a fixed curve point has at most 2s eligible distinct-abscissa partners for s slopes. Independent subgroup records give first-join admission at most 2Jb^2s/r and, after rejection loss at most 1/4, at most 8Jb^2s/(3r). W fresh bases give at most 8WJb^2s/(3r), decaying as 2^(-n+o(n)) at the stated balanced parameters with subexponential s,W. This rejects that fixed-slope schedule, not adaptive or other coordinate joins. Shared source867527c and canonical gate141/0/0 check actual Weierstrass fibre counts; conditioning/cost remain hand arguments. Complete logs and source hashes are retained.
